get.summary: Obtain status of an asynchronous operation.
get.description: Obtains information about the status of an asynchronous operation, such as group memberships that are being updated. Various REST APIs that start asynchronous operations return a URL that points to this API. Use this API to determine whether the asynchronous operation is still running, it failed, or it finished successfully and to determine the result of the operation. By default, the information about the operation is available for at least 48 hours; then it is discarded. Only Business Automation Workflow administrators or users who initiated the asynchronous call are authorized to perform this call.

parameters.name: BPMCSRFToken
parameters.description: Cross-site request forgery prevention token for Business Automation Workflow REST APIs.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier of the operation, obtained from the REST API that started the asynchronous operation.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Authorization key, obtained from the REST API that started the asynchronous operation. Administrators can query an operation status without any authorization key; in all other cases, the authorization key is mandatory to ensure that only callers who started the operation can query its status.

200.description: The status of the specified operation is returned in the response

400.description: The request contains invalid parameter

403.description: The caller is not authorized to perform the request.

parameters.description: A string that uses the given term to filters the process instances that are returned.

delete.summary: Delete specified process instances.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Set this parameter to the value 'true' if you want to delete process instances regardless of whether they are in an end state.

parameters.name: ended_before
parameters.description: Only process instances that completed before this point in time are deleted. Specify the time in ISO 8601 format 'yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssz'.

parameters.name: ended_after
parameters.description: Only process instances that completed after this point in time are deleted. Specify the time in ISO 8601 format 'yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssz'.

parameters.name: process_ids
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of process instance identifiers.

parameters.name: transaction_slice
parameters.description: Specifies the number of instances that are deleted per transaction. The default value is 10.

202.description: The request to delete the specified process instances was submitted. To check the progress of the operation, use the 'GET /system/queue/{id}' resource to access the URL that is included in the response.

204.description: No instances that match the request were found to delete.

400.description: The request contains parameters that are not valid, or they are missing.

403.description: The caller is not authorized to perform the request.
